responsibility: This file implements out-of-SSA conversion and register allocation for GCC’s internal HSA IL. It first performs a naive PHI elimination by inserting moves on predecessor edges, then computes HSA register-class-specific liveness and live intervals, applies a linear-scan allocator over the HSA virtual registers, assigns hard register numbers where possible, and rewrites instructions to honor spills through generated load/store helpers when intervals cannot be kept in registers. Its responsibility is the backend register-assignment phase for the HSA IL just before BRIG emission.
